summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes 12-17 m off the first few metres.
reasons: Dwellings 12-17 m away on own side

best_section.where: Start of the stretch, just before the house frontage on the north side

drivers.seclusion: Houses line the north side at 12 m and 17 m; a 6 m house starts at 14 m along, so only the first few metres are clear of it.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parked car and truck at the kerb, so room to pull in is plausible.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential bend; light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but no sign of campers; residential street with no overnight convention.

flags: Steep: about 3% mean grade over the stretch, 5.6% max
Low-lying: Witton Creek mapped about 1 m away, min elevation 35 m (not under 5 m)
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the north-east and a house block morning sun from the north side.
